description: This file defines interfaces for warning reporting control and warning events within the WPEFramework. It includes interface classes for warning events, reporting units, and control mechanisms, outlining methods for serialization, string conversion, event reporting, and category management.

classes.name: IWarningEvent
classes.description: Interface for warning events, supporting serialization, deserialization, category, and warning status queries.

classes.name: IWarningReportingUnit
classes.description: Interface for warning reporting units, responsible for reporting events, fetching category info, and managing category controls.

classes.name: IWarningReportingControl
classes.description: Nested interface within IWarningReportingUnit, for control operations like exclusion and configuration of warning categories.

methods.name: Exclude
methods.description: Exclude a specified category or item from reporting or processing.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configure settings for a warning category or reporting control.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Create a copy of the warning reporting control object.

methods.name: ReportWarningEvent
methods.description: Report a warning event with a given identifier and event information.

methods.name: FetchCategoryInformation
methods.description: Retrieve information about a specific warning category, including default status, enabled state, exclusions, and configuration.

methods.name: AddToCategoryList
methods.description: Add a warning reporting control to the category list.

methods.name: RemoveFromCategoryList
methods.description: Remove a warning reporting control from the category list.
